command:
require 'json'; require 'digest'; require 'open3'
base="reports/physical_bridge_2026_09_05/"
pins=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"SIGNED_LEVEL_INPUTS.json"))["inputs"]+
 JSON.parse(File.read(base+"SIGNED_LEVEL_CONTEXT.json"))["post_identification_context"]
pins.each do |r|
 b,e,s=Open3.capture3("git","show",r["commit"]+":"+r["path"])
 abort(e) unless s.success?
 abort("source hash "+r["path"]) unless Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(b)==r["sha256"]
end
seal=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"SIGNED_LEVEL_SEAL.json"))
seal["paths"].each{|r|abort("science hash "+r["path"]) unless Digest::SHA256.file(r["path"]).hexdigest==r["sha256"]}
receipts=JSON.parse(File.read(base+"SIGNED_LEVEL_RECEIPTS.json"))
receipts["runs"].each{|n,r|b=r["stdout"]; abort("raw hash "+n) unless b.bytesize==r["receipt"]["log_bytes"]&&Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(b)==r["receipt"]["log_sha256"]}
latest={}
File.foreach(base+"ARTIFACT_HASHES.txt"){|l|m=/\A([0-9a-f]{64})  (.+)\n?\z/.match(l);latest[m[2].strip]=m[1] if m}
bad=latest.filter{|p,h|!File.file?(p)||Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest!=h}
abort(JSON.generate(bad)) unless bad.empty?
links=[]
[base+"SIGNED_LEVEL.md",base+"GENESIS_PREMISE_REGISTER.md"].each do |p|
 File.read(p).scan(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/).flatten.each do |target|
  next if target.start_with?("https:","http:","#")
  full=File.expand_path(target.split("#").first,File.dirname(p))
  rel=full.delete_prefix(Dir.pwd+"/")
  o,e,s=Open3.capture3("git","ls-files","--error-unmatch",rel)
  abort("untracked link "+target) unless File.file?(full)&&s.success?
  links << rel
 end
end
paths=Open3.capture2("git","diff","--cached","--name-only").first.lines.map(&:strip)
abort("R77 staged") if paths.any?{|p|p.include?("SOURCE_CORE")||p.end_with?("source_core.py")}
puts JSON.pretty_generate({source_pins:pins.length,science_paths:seal["paths"].length,embedded_raw_captures:receipts["runs"].length,latest_artifact_digests:latest.length,tracked_links:links.length,staged_paths:paths.length,all_hashes_match:true,R77_excluded:true,scientific_source_repair:false,full_scientific_suite_green:false})
